model.distancePrecedence: Gyeonggi exact routeId+staOrder+stationId BMS cumulative delta, then BMS GIS segment, then consecutive haversine times roadDetourFactor; Seoul uses the same haversine fallback

gyeonggi.dataset: GBIS baseinfoservice v2 route and routeStation
gyeonggi.headwayPolicy: weekday peekAlloc, then weekday npeekAlloc, then defaultHeadwayMin; accepted commuter range 2..60 minutes

bms.realDistancePolicy: reported for coverage only; never primary

seoul.headwayPolicy: busRteInfo has no current headway field; conservative default 15 minutes
